heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service category.

items.question: What types of games do you develop?
items.answer: We develop 2D and 3D mobile games, casual and hyper-casual games, multiplayer games, and AR and VR experiences for iOS, Android, Windows and Mac.

items.question: Which engine do you use?
items.answer: Primarily Unity, because it supports 2D, 3D, AR and VR across platforms from one project. We recommend the best tool for your game after reviewing your concept.

items.question: How long does it take to develop a game?
items.answer: A simple casual game can take 2 to 3 months, while a polished 3D or multiplayer game typically takes 6 months or more depending on scope.

items.question: Can you help with monetization?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate ads, in-app purchases and rewards, and design them around the gameplay so they support retention.

items.question: Do you support the game after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide bug fixes, updates, new levels and events, and analytics-driven balancing.
